column12: Case Instructions  Please read the following instructions carefully.  You will be asked to report your beliefs about a topic. You will need to choose one position.  You must not consult any external sources, including the internet, chatbots, books, or any other reference materials.  Responses should be based solely on your existing knowledge and personal beliefs. There are no correct or incorrect answers; the objective is to capture your individual judgment.
column13: Mirror Life  The following statements are about mirror life:  Statement 1: Humans have successfully synthesized mirror molecules, which are chemical structures that are exact mirror images of naturally occurring biological molecules. Mirror molecules have the same atoms as normal biological molecules, but they are arranged in opposite “left-handed” or “right-handed” forms. While life on Earth uses only one version, scientists can create the mirror versions.  Statement 2: Humans have not successfully synthesized mirror molecules, which are supposed to be chemical structures that are exact mirror images of naturally occurring biological molecules. These so-called mirror molecules have the same atoms as normal biological molecules arranged in opposite “left-handed” or “right-handed” forms. Although life on Earth is said to use only one version, scientists are unable to create mirror versions of biological molecules.
